itemUsage.en: Sakiko Togawa, keyboardist and composer of Ave Mujica. A well-bred young lady who is kind, gentle, yet brimming with confidence and fiercely strong-minded.
itemUsage.zh: Ave Mujica键盘手和作曲担当丰川祥子，是位温柔体贴又自信要强的大小姐。

itemDesc.en: She continues to grow, casting aside naiveté and weakness, becoming one who can shoulder her companions' lives.
itemDesc.zh: 她会一步一步成长，丢掉自己的幼稚和软弱，成长为一位能肩负起同伴一生的人。

description.en:
Performs <@ba.vup>8</> notes; the Arts damage dealt by each note starts at <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK but gradually reduces to <@ba.vup>{atk_scale_8:0%}</>;
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges; releases 1 charge automatically when charges are full</>
description.zh: 演奏出<@ba.vup>8</>个音符。每个音符造成的法术伤害依次从攻击力的<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>逐渐降低至<@ba.vup>{atk_scale_8:0%}</>。\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次，充能至最大层数时自动释放一次</>

description.en:
<@ba.rem>Swap between performing on the <@ba.vup>piano (starting)</> and <@ba.vup>organ</> timbres.</>
<@ba.vup>Piano</>: ATK <@ba.vup>+{attack@atk:0%}</>, notes fly faster; notes pierce enemies, dealing <@ba.vup>Physical damage</>
<@ba.vup>Organ</>: ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack@attack_speed}</>, notes deal <@ba.vup>Arts damage</> and fly slower
<@ba.rem>During <$ba.fever>Fever</>, the current timbre deals double strikes</>
description.zh:
<@ba.rem>可以切换<@ba.vup>钢琴（初始）</>或<@ba.vup>风琴</>音色演奏：</>
<@ba.vup>钢琴</>：攻击力<@ba.vup>+{attack@atk:0%}</>，音符飞行速度加快，命中目标后穿过敌人造成<@ba.vup>物理伤害</>
<@ba.vup>风琴</>：攻击速度<@ba.vup>+{attack@attack_speed}</>，音符造成<@ba.vup>法术伤害</>且飞行速度减缓 
<@ba.rem><$ba.fever>Fever</>期间变为当前音色的二连击</>

description.en:
Attack Range expands, performs on both <@ba.vup>piano</> and <@ba.vup>organ</> timbres at once, each timbre creating <@ba.vup>2</> notes that deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical and Arts damage respectively, which home in on the enemy with the highest RES or DEF respectively
<@ba.rem>During <$ba.fever>Fever</>, <$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</> members who receive fatal damage will not retreat until <$ba.fever>Fever</> is over</>
description.zh: 攻击范围扩大，攻击同时使用<@ba.vup>钢琴</>和<@ba.vup>风琴</>音色演奏，各自演奏<@ba.vup>2</>个造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>物理和法术伤害的音符，且分别追踪法术抗性和防御力最高的敌人。\n<@ba.rem><$ba.fever>Fever</>期间<$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</>成员受到致命伤害时不撤退，<$ba.fever>Fever</>结束后退场</>

description.en: The studio is Sakiko's favorite place in all of Rhodes Island. Not because it is full of instruments, nor because music lovers gather there. What Sakiko enjoys is entering the studio while others aren't around, to play the piano by herself. She plays to practice, to improve, to win, but also to relax. Whenever something weighs on her mind, there she'd show up, placing the doll from Iris next to her, unraveling her tangled feelings through music. Such are her rare moments of solace. One such day, Sakiko discovers a note left on the piano. 'Sakiko, thank you for such beautiful piano playing.' Plain, unbeguiling handwriting. Someone young and easygoing, perhaps. The notes continued, appearing from time to time. It seems their writer is quite the shy type. No name left on them, and the writer is never to be seen in person either. Unwilling to interrupt these precious me time of Sakiko, perhaps. Whoever they are, they communicate their thoughts to Sakiko day after day. Whoever they are, they praise Sakiko in every regard. Even for how cute her doll is. For the composure she carries herself with. Whoever they are, they praise Sakiko's piano playing. Her loss, her strength. Whoever they are, they thank Sakiko for weaving such sound. In their times of weakness, Sakiko's piano has become something they may lean on. Whoever they are, they hope to perform with Sakiko. Whoever they are, they encourage Sakiko. For they can hear Sakiko's loneliness. They support Sakiko with all their heart, even though they know nothing about her problems. An old friend comes to Sakiko's mind. Perhaps this mysterious one is just like that friend, always struggling to put her feelings into words. If Sakiko simply looks into the studio's usage records, or shifts her practice times, she'd learn who this mystery correspondent is in no time. But Sakiko does not do that. Before we leave Rhodes Island, I want to perform with them. Just what kind of person could they be? Sensitive? Considerate? Quiet? Timid? Would they be like Mutsumi? Or Uika? Whatever the case, they must definitely be a violin player—Sakiko's hunch told her that much, at least.
description.zh:
在罗德岛本舰上，祥子最喜欢的地方无疑是音乐排练室。
倒不是喜欢里面琳琅满目的乐器，和热情的音乐爱好者们。
祥子喜欢避开大家使用排练室的时间，一人在此弹琴，她很享受这片刻。
对祥子来说，弹钢琴既是练习、是目标、是工作，也是放松、是寄托。
她把爱丽丝送给自己的人偶也放在这里，每每遇到令她心烦意乱的事，祥子总会来到排练室把情绪宣泄进琴声里。在这短暂的时间里，祥子才能感到些许慰藉。
这天，她在琴边发现了这样一张字条——
“祥子小姐，你的琴声真的很美。谢谢你。”
字迹干净清爽，看上去像是来自某个单纯友善的年轻人。
在那之后，祥子经常能发现，钢琴前有字条留给自己。
这是一位害羞的听众。
这个听众不愿意透露自己是谁，她（或者是他？）刻意不出现在祥子的面前，因为她也不想破坏祥子的这宝贵的时光。
她想用这样的形式把她想要告诉祥子的话说出来。
她称赞祥子的一举一动，称赞祥子的人偶，称赞祥子的成熟。
她称赞祥子的琴声里，隐藏在纠结、迷茫之下的坚强。
她感谢祥子的琴声，因为这琴声在她脆弱时支持了她。
她期待自己能跟祥子一起演奏。
她也会鼓励祥子，她能听到祥子琴声中的寂寞，即使她不知道祥子的难处是什么，但是她也愿意为她加油。
祥子想起了故乡的一位旧伙伴，真巧，这位听众也是个不知道该如何开口的笨拙的人吧。
其实只要稍稍调查，找找训练室的使用记录，变一变练习的时间来打乱对方的习惯，祥子应该能很快找出这位听众。
但是她并没有这么做。
祥子决定，等她离开前，她想要和这位听众见见面，并邀请她一起演奏一曲。
她是个什么样的人呢？心思细腻，温和体贴?不善言辞，胆小害怕？
是跟睦一样呢，还是会跟初华一样呢？
她应该是一位小提琴手，祥子毫无依据，但是这样觉得。
